nodes.name: Agreement
nodes.doc:
Agreement between two labellings.

Attributes:
    n: the number of items labelled twice.
    same: how many got the same answer both times.
    observed: ``same / n``.
    chance: the agreement expected from the answer frequencies alone.
    kappa: Cohen's kappa.

nodes.name: agreement
nodes.doc:
Agreement between two labellings of the same items, in the same order.

Raises:
    ValueError: if the two lists differ in length or are empty.

nodes.name: Alignment
nodes.doc:
Step 2's result for one pair.

Attributes:
    ncc: normalised cross-correlation of the grey overlap (-1 when no alignment
        keeps `MIN_OVERLAP` of the grid).
    scale: the second photo's scale onto the first.
    shift: its shift in pixels of the 128 grid (rows, columns).
    mirrored: whether the second photo was mirrored.
    overlap: the share of the grid both photos cover.
    ssim: SSIM of the grey overlap.
    mad_rgb: mean absolute RGB difference of the overlap, 0-255.

nodes.name: CheapScores
nodes.doc:
Step 1's scores for every pair i < j (flat arrays in `np.triu_indices` order).

Attributes:
    i: the first photo's index.
    j: the second photo's index.
    corr: the 16 x 16 grey correlation.
    corr_mirror: the same against the second photo mirrored left-right.
    hamming: the perceptual hashes' Hamming distance (0 = identical hash).

nodes.name: _placed
nodes.doc:
``b`` scaled and shifted, and where it covers the grid (without the grid's
`EDGE` px border when ``trim``).

nodes.name: _scaled
nodes.doc:
``img`` zoomed by ``s`` about its centre, back on its grid, and where real
pixels landed.

nodes.name: aligned_similarity
nodes.doc: Step 2: align photo b onto photo a (128 px RGB thumbnails) and compare.

nodes.name: candidates
nodes.doc:
Indices into ``s`` of the pairs worth a precise score.

Args:
    s: step 1's scores.
    clip: optional unit-length CLIP image features, one row per photo. Any two cat
        photos have a high CLIP cosine, so only very high ones count, and a
        photo's nearest neighbour a little lower.

Returns:
    The selected pair indices, sorted.

nodes.name: cheap_scores
nodes.doc: Step 1 for every pair of the (n, 64, 64) grey thumbnails.

nodes.name: cross_split_pairs
nodes.doc: The pairs whose two photos are in different splits (the leaks).

nodes.name: group_split
nodes.doc:
A split in which every group of copies is on one side.

A group goes to the first split in ``order`` that any of its photos already has
(so evaluation photos stay where they are and their training copies move out of
training); photos in no group keep their split.

Args:
    split: photo name to split name.
    copies: the duplicate groups (`groups`).
    order: which split wins when a group spans several.

Returns:
    The new photo-to-split mapping.

nodes.name: groups
nodes.doc: Join pairs of copies into groups (connected components), largest first.

nodes.name: thumbnails
nodes.doc: The 64 px grey and 128 px RGB thumbnails (uint8) of each photo.

nodes.name: Cut
nodes.doc:
What removing every cat scored above a threshold does to the labelled cats.

Attributes:
    threshold: the cut.
    removed: cats removed.
    wrongly_removed_share: of the removed, the share labelled clear.
    unclear_caught: labelled-unclear cats removed.
    clear_lost: labelled-clear cats removed.

nodes.name: EyeMeasure
nodes.doc:
One eye measured inside the sketch plan's outline (256 px cut-out).

Attributes:
    eye_px: the outline's area in pixels.
    pupil_ok: the plan found a real pupil (not a sliver).
    contrast: the iris's median lightness (L*) minus the pupil's.
    score: ``contrast`` when ``pupil_ok``, else 0.
    iris_lab: the iris's median L*, a*, b*.

nodes.name: Interval
nodes.doc: A statistic with a percentile bootstrap interval.

nodes.name: bootstrap
nodes.doc:
A bootstrap interval for "auc" or "accuracy" (at 0.5) of out-of-fold scores.

The labelled cats are resampled with replacement ``n`` times; the interval is the
middle ``level`` of the statistic over the resamples.

nodes.name: calibration
nodes.doc:
Reliability: for each score bin, the mean score, the share truly unclear and the
count (empty bins left out).

nodes.name: clip_input
nodes.doc: Images as CLIP's input: 224 px, scaled to 0-1, normalised, channels first.

nodes.name: crop_features
nodes.doc:
One cat's feature from its three unit-length crop embeddings (3, 512): both eyes,
then the element-wise min and max of the two single eyes (so left and right do not
matter), 1536 numbers.

nodes.name: crops
nodes.doc: Three crops of the levelled photo: both eyes, the image's left eye, the right.

nodes.name: cut
nodes.doc: The effect of removing the cats with P(unclear) above ``threshold``.

nodes.name: cv_scores
nodes.doc: Out-of-fold P(unclear) for every labelled cat (stratified k-fold).

nodes.name: eye_measures
nodes.doc:
Measure each eye of a cut-out photo (RGB 0-1) inside the plan's outlines.

Args:
    photo: the 256 px cut-out, float RGB in 0-1.
    eyes: each eye's outline (m, 2) on the 256 grid.
    pupils: each pupil's ellipse: centre x, y, the two radii and the angle.

nodes.name: level
nodes.doc:
The photo turned about the eyes' midpoint so the eyes are level.

Returns:
    The turned image, the eyes' midpoint, the eye distance and the two eyes'
    positions after turning.

nodes.name: measured_row
nodes.doc:
The five measured numbers of a cat (see `MEASURED`), unscaled.

The smaller eye's area over the eye distance squared (squinting), the smaller over
the larger (one eye hidden), the irises' lightness and colour gaps (a shadow over
one eye), and the worse eye's pupil score.

nodes.name: model
nodes.doc: The classifier.

nodes.name: nested_threshold
nodes.doc:
Choose the threshold inside each outer fold and measure it on that fold.

For every outer fold, the threshold is picked (`pick_threshold`) from inner
out-of-fold scores of the other folds, then a model fitted on those folds scores
the held fold and the cut is applied there. Nothing about the held fold informs its
threshold.

Returns:
    The threshold each fold chose, and the pooled cut over all held folds.

nodes.name: pick_threshold
nodes.doc:
The lowest threshold whose removed cats are at most ``max_wrong`` clear ones
(so the most unclear cats are caught at that cost); the highest of the grid when
none qualifies.

nodes.name: standardise
nodes.doc:
Measured rows (n, 5, NaN where missing) standardised over all cats, missing
values set to 0, and a sixth column flagging the cats with a missing value.

nodes.name: Cutout
nodes.doc:
The painter's input for one cat (the fields `brushgpt.cat.load_inputs` reads).

Attributes:
    target: the head on white, (256, 256, 3) uint8.
    tri: (256, 256) uint8, 0 background, 1 head, 2 uncertain.
    points: the nine face points on the 256 grid, float32.
    box: the square in the photo's pixels (left, top, right, bottom).

nodes.name: Measures
nodes.doc:
The numbers the quality rules read (see `photo2painting.rules`).

Attributes:
    eye_dist_px: distance between the eyes in the photo's pixels.
    face_cover: share of the face hull inside the mask (`face_cover`).
    tip_cover: the mask's value near each ear tip, the smaller of the two
        (0 when a tip is outside the photo).
    tips_in_photo: both ear tips within `TIP_SLACK` eye distances of the photo.
    eye_contrast: standard deviation of the luminance near the eyes; a photo too
        dark to see the eyes has almost none.
    eye_lum: mean luminance near the eyes.
    photo_w: the photo's width in pixels.
    photo_h: the photo's height in pixels.

nodes.name: RawCat
nodes.doc:
One raw photo and what comes with it.

Attributes:
    source: "afhq" or "cat" (the CAT dataset).
    cat_id: the photo's name within its source.
    photo: path to the photo file.
    mask: path to the subject mask (a grey image, white = cat).
    points: the nine face points in the photo's pixels, shape (9, 2).

methods.name: name

nodes.name: afhq_cats
nodes.doc:
The AFHQ cats with predicted face points.

Args:
    labels: an .npz with ``ids`` (paths relative to ``photos``) and ``points``.
    photos: the AFHQ root folder.
    masks: the folder of subject masks, ``<stem>_mask1.png``.

Yields:
    One RawCat per photo, in the order of the labels file.

nodes.name: cat_dataset_cats
nodes.doc:
The CAT dataset's cats that have a subject mask, with their hand-placed points.

Args:
    zips: the dataset's zip files; each photo has a ``.jpg.cat`` text file next to
        it: the number of points (9), then 18 numbers, x and y of each point.
    photos: where the photos were extracted, named ``<zip>__<folder>__<file>.jpg``.
    masks: the folder of subject masks, ``<stem>_mask1.png``.

Yields:
    One RawCat per photo with a mask, sorted by name.

nodes.name: cutout
nodes.doc: Cut the head out of a photo onto the 256 px grid (see the module docstring).

nodes.name: face_cover
nodes.doc:
The share of the face that the subject mask calls cat.

The face is the convex hull of the eyes, the mouth and the four ear bases (the ear
tips are left out: between two tips the hull is background). A mask that misses
part of the face would put white paper into the painting's face.

nodes.name: head_box
nodes.doc: The square around a head mask, `CROP_MARGIN` times its larger side.

nodes.name: head_shape
nodes.doc:
The head alone as a boolean mask of ``shape`` (height, width).

In the face's frame: a superellipse (power `HEAD_POWER`) from the highest ear base
down to `HEAD_CHIN` below the mouth, as wide as the widest ear base or half an eye
distance plus `HEAD_SIDE`; plus each ear's triangle scaled by `EAR_SCALE` about its
centre and widened by `EAR_PAD`. Generous on purpose: the ear's real edge comes
from the subject mask it is intersected with.

nodes.name: load
nodes.doc: The photo (RGB) and its subject mask resized to the photo, 0-1.

nodes.name: luminance
nodes.doc: Luminance (ITU-R 601 weights) of an RGB image in 0-1.

nodes.name: measure
nodes.doc: Measure one photo for the quality rules.

nodes.name: parse_cat_points
nodes.doc: The nine points of a CAT dataset ``.cat`` file, shape (9, 2).

nodes.name: square
nodes.doc: A square box (left, top, right, bottom) of ``side`` pixels about ``centre``.

nodes.name: ScanSummary
nodes.doc:
A folder of paintings scanned.

Attributes:
    paintings: how many paintings were checked.
    bad_canvas: names of the paintings whose canvas is not finite.
    bad_strokes: names of the paintings with a non-finite stroke.

nodes.name: StageCheck
nodes.doc:
One stage file checked.

Attributes:
    canvas_finite: every canvas pixel is finite.
    bad_strokes: per layer index, how many strokes have a non-finite field.

methods.name: ok

nodes.name: bad_stroke_mask
nodes.doc: For one layer, True for each stroke with any non-finite field.

nodes.name: check_stage
nodes.doc: Check one stage file.

nodes.name: scan
nodes.doc: Check the given stage of every painting folder (one folder per cat).

nodes.name: Thresholds
nodes.doc:
The rules' thresholds.

Attributes:
    min_face: the face hull's share inside the mask; below it, "face cut".
    min_tip: the mask's value near the ear tips; below it, "ear cut".
    min_contrast: the luminance spread near the eyes; below it, "too dark".
    min_eye_px: the eye distance in pixels; below it, "eyes too small".

nodes.name: ear_reason
nodes.doc:
Why an ear cannot teach the ear model, or "" when it can.

Its base must be inside the photo and wide enough, and its middle inside the mask
(not hidden or cut away). A cut-off tip is fine.

nodes.name: reasons
nodes.doc:
For each model in `MODELS`, why the photo is left out ("" = kept).

Args:
    m: the photo's measures (`photo2painting.ingest.measure`).
    points: the nine face points in the photo's pixels.
    mask: the subject mask, 0-1, the photo's size.
    t: the thresholds; the defaults when None.

Returns:
    A dict from model name to the reasons, joined by "; ".
